reading_rule.title: Four questions before you believe it
subs: Any claim that a small fine-tuned model beat a big prompted one,
checked against six years of BANKING77 results.
rows: What did the big model get to see?
Names, examples, or hand-picked examples. GPT-4 scored 74.2% with three random examples per intent and 83.1% with three an expert chose (Loukas et al., 2023).
How many labels did the small one get?
Fine-tuned BERT scored 83.4% with 10 labelled messages per intent, 90.0% with 30, and 93.7% with all of them (Casanueva et al., 2020).
Who wrote the answers it learned from?
Preply's Qwen3.5-0.8B learned from GPT-5.4's annotations, checked and filtered first, then beat prompted GPT-5.4 on tests people had labelled (Celikik et al., 2026).
None of these studies changes the label set after training. Your business will.
